doc.title: Line Start-Up
doc.purpose: Start a packaging line safely and reach approved production in the shortest time.

roles.name: Line Lead
roles.does: Owns the start-up and signs the checklist.

references.as_written: WI-210 Filler Setup and Nozzle Check
WI-211 Capper Setup and Torque Check
WI-212 Labeler Setup and Label Roll Change
WI-213 Case Packer Setup and Glue Check

parameters.what: stop length that requires a full start-up
parameters.quote: Applies at the start of every shift and after any stop longer than 60 minutes.
Check compressed air at the line regulator: 6.2 bar minimum.

parameters.what: maximum line speed before first-off approval
parameters.quote: Start conveyors (CNV-1, CNV-2, CNV-3), then the filler at 50% speed.
Run 20 bottles and stop. Take the first-off samples to the QA Technician.
After approval, ramp to the scheduled rate over 5 minutes.

parameters.what: first fill weight check after start
parameters.quote: Take the first fill weight check within 15 minutes of start
then every 30 minutes for the rest of the shift, as described in QP-303.

rules.statement: The Maintenance Technician removes locks after maintenance work, and the Line Lead confirms all locks and tags are removed.
The QA Technician approves or rejects the first-off as described in QP-306.
rules.quote: Approve or reject the first-off as described in QP-306.

rules.statement: The Line Lead owns the start-up and signs the checklist.
rules.quote: Owns the start-up and signs the checklist.

unsure.what: Step 12 has the Operator run 20 bottles before first-off samples; QP-306 asks for the first 5 good bottles and one packed case
unsure.why: Not clear whether the 20 bottles include the 5; the case sample is not mentioned in SOP-101
